title: Dynamic Application Security Testing Report
scan.baseline: OWASP ZAP baseline scan: crawl ({minutes} min) and check the responses
note.none: No alert was raised on the crawled pages.
note.noneEndToEnd: No alert was raised on the pages of the End-to-End tests.
note.passive: The baseline scan crawls the site and checks its requests and responses; it sends no attacks, so it does not find every vulnerability.
scan.full: OWASP ZAP full scan: crawl ({minutes} min), check the responses and attack (up to {scanMinutes} min)
note.active: The full scan attacks the pages and their parameters, e.g. with scripts and SQL, as an attacker would; it finds many vulnerabilities, but not all, e.g. those of the pages that it did not crawl.
endToEnd.failed: The tests failed (exit code {code}): the pages after the failure may not be scanned
scan.endToEnd.baseline: OWASP ZAP: check the requests and responses of the End-to-End tests
scan.endToEnd.full: OWASP ZAP: check the requests and responses of the End-to-End tests, and attack them (up to {scanMinutes} min)
ignored.title: Alerts of the ignored IDs
ignored.description: These alerts were raised, but --ignore leaves them out of the result: they do not fail the scan. Check that each still does not apply, e.g. after a change of the web server.
checks.passed.note: The scan rules of ZAP that ran and raised no alert on the site.
checks.notRun.note: The scan rules that did not run, and why: they raised nothing because they checked nothing.
checks.notRun.limit: The active scan reached its time limit ({minutes} min): the rules that it had not started are not listed.
notRun.skipped: Skipped by ZAP: not for the technology of the site, no page to attack, or a time limit
notRun.active.title: The rules of the active scan (attacks)
notRun.baseline: The baseline scan sends no attacks: run the full scan (--scan=full) on a test environment
